test_word_dropout_with_eos: test the WordDropout noising class to drop words from BPE-tokenized source tensors with EOS
test_word_blanking_with_eos: test the WordDropout noising class to blank words with UNK tokens in BPE source tensors
test_word_shuffle_with_eos: test the WordShuffle noising class to shuffle words within a max distance on BPE tokens
test_noising_dataset_with_eos: test the NoisingDataset with UnsupervisedMTNoising to generate noisy source and clean target batches
test_word_shuffle_with_bpe_end_marker: test the WordShuffle noising class using BPE end-of-word markers instead of continuation markers
